# Textarea: `jl-textarea`

A text field of several lines that can grow with its text and count its characters.

- Class `JlTextarea`, an atom: `import { JlTextarea } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/textarea

A text field of several lines that takes part in forms like a native textarea: give it a name and its
value is in the form's data, required stops the submission, a reset brings back the value written in the HTML.

rows sets the height. With autosize the field grows with its text, from rows up to max-rows lines, and scrolls
after that. A maxlength stops the typing at that length and shows a counter under the field.

## Use

```ts
import { JlTextarea } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlTextarea
  autosize
  maxRows={8}
  maxlength="200"
  placeholder="Tell us about your project"
/>
```

```html
<jl-textarea
  autosize
  max-rows="8"
  maxlength="200"
  placeholder="Tell us about your project"
></jl-textarea>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `value` (attribute `value`): `string`, default `''`. The text.
- `placeholder` (attribute `placeholder`): `string`, default `''`. Shown while empty.
- `rows` (attribute `rows`): `number`, default `3`. The height in lines; the least an autosized field shows.
- `autosize` (attribute `autosize`): `boolean`, default `false`. Grows with the text instead of scrolling, up to max-rows.
- `maxRows` (attribute `max-rows`): `number`, default `0`. The most lines an autosized field grows to before it scrolls; 0 for no limit.
- `maxlength` (attribute `maxlength`): `string`, default `''`. The most characters it takes; shows a counter under the field.
- `name` (attribute `name`): `string`, default `''`. The field's name in the form's data.
- `label` (attribute `label`): `string`, default `''`. The accessible name, when no visible label names the field.
- `required` (attribute `required`): `boolean`, default `false`. The form cannot be submitted while it is empty.
- `readonly` (attribute `readonly`): `boolean`, default `false`. Can be read and copied, not changed.
- `disabled` (attribute `disabled`): `boolean`, default `false`. Cannot be changed or focused.
- `invalid` (attribute `invalid`): `boolean`, default `false`. Drawn in the danger colour, for an error the page found.

## Events

In JSX, the `on…` prop, its handler given the detail; in code, `events.register(name, (detail) => …)`. They do not bubble.

- `input` (`onInput` in JSX), detail `string`: Each change as people type.
- `change` (`onChange` in JSX), detail `string`: The text was committed: the field lost the focus after a change.

## Methods

- `focus(options?: FocusOptions): void`: Focuses the native field.
- `select(): void`: Selects the whole text.
- `checkValidity(): boolean`: Whether the value meets its constraints (required, maxlength).
- `reportValidity(): boolean`: The same check; when it fails, the browser shows its message on the control.

## Styling

- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The frame around the text area.

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### Rows

rows sets the height; the field can be resized by its corner.

```html
<div class="stack narrow">
  <jl-textarea placeholder="A short note" rows="2"></jl-textarea>
  <jl-textarea placeholder="Describe the issue" rows="5"></jl-textarea>
</div>
```

### Autosize

It starts at two lines, grows as you type, and scrolls past six.

```html
<div class="narrow">
  <jl-textarea autosize rows="2" max-rows="6" placeholder="Write a message…"></jl-textarea>
</div>
```

### Character counter

The counter turns to the warning colour once the limit is reached.

```html
<div class="narrow">
  <jl-textarea
    maxlength="120"
    label="Bio"
    value="Designer and developer in Lausanne. I build quiet tools for busy teams."
  ></jl-textarea>
</div>
```

### States

```html
<div class="stack narrow">
  <jl-textarea label="Read only" value="Read only: it can be selected and copied." readonly rows="2"></jl-textarea>
  <jl-textarea label="Disabled" value="Disabled" disabled rows="2"></jl-textarea>
  <jl-textarea label="Summary" value="Too short" invalid rows="2"></jl-textarea>
</div>
```

### Listening

The paragraph listens to input and counts the words.

```html
<div class="stack narrow">
  <jl-textarea class="demo-words" autosize placeholder="Type a few words"></jl-textarea>
  <p class="muted demo-count">0 words</p>
</div>
```

```js
const area = root.querySelector('.demo-words');
const count = root.querySelector('.demo-count');
area.events.register('input', (text) => {
  const words = text.trim() === '' ? 0 : text.trim().split(/\s+/).length;
  count.textContent = `${words} ${words === 1 ? 'word' : 'words'}`;
});
```
